title: EasyFreezy
body:
![Freeze screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f29a35d9867adc8367b4d4a7152b77b7b928849.png)
# 🚫Plugin that adds freezing 
### Consider your regular ban system with message customization. yeah reinvented the bicycle lmao

**✨Features:**
- HEX Color support
- Custom config.yml
- Very simple and non-loading plugin

**🏗️Commands:**
- `/easyf freeze [name]` - freeze a player account
- `/easyf unfreeze [name]` - unfreeze a player account
- `/easyf reload` - reload configuration
- `/easyf help` - show list commands

**❌️`config.yml` not has preview, because this file on Russian language**

**❌️`regions.yml` not has preview**

*The plugin was custom made for one person for one server. I was allowed to publish it, but unfortunately I was not paid for advertising the server :)*
